subject: Acme renewal: proposed shift to marketplace billing and co-sell flow
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal and billing: migrating to Marketplace

Hi Vanessa,

We have an upcoming renewal for Redwood services (term ends 2026-09-30) and Procurement has asked whether we can move to marketplace billing (AWS and Azure) instead of a direct invoice. Main asks from Acme: 

- Consolidated marketplace invoices for cloud spend reconciliation
- Standard marketplace terms to satisfy our internal PO process
- A clean path so we don’t lose current usage credits / discounts

I attached a rough mutual action plan from our side (Acme-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx) showing timing constraints — PO needs to be issued by Aug 20 to hit our internal cycle. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports multi-cloud marketplace billing and what the transition steps look like? Also curious if there are co-sell incentives we should be aware of.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, Acme Corporation
samir.patel@acme.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal and billing: migrating to Marketplace

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear timing and the MAP. Short answer: yes, we can move ACME to marketplace billing on AWS and Azure; GCP is possible but usually takes slightly longer.

High-level transition plan (we can refine on a 30-min call):

1) Confirm pricing parity and credits: we’ll mirror the effective unit pricing from the direct contract for the first renewal period to avoid any cost delta.
2) Marketplace listing & registration: Marissa will coordinate vendor registration and listing activation with AWS/Azure co-sell teams. Typical vendor activation is 7–10 business days once we have the required paperwork.
3) Billing onboarding: Neha will set up the billing transfer, invoice routing, and ensure PO compatibility (tax fields, remit-to).
4) Contract & procurement: We can provide a Marketplace Order Form + a short addendum to preserve any committed discounts.
5) Go-live checklist & rollback: confirm invoice sample, test PO acceptance, and keep a 30-day fallback window to direct invoicing if anything breaks.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick call on Mon 2026-08-02 to align on PO date and required fields (15–30 mins)
- I’ll attach our Redwood Marketplace FAQ and an updated MAP draft after the call.

I’ve copied Marissa (marketplace partnerships) and Neha (billing ops) to own their portions. Marissa — can you confirm expected activation ETA for an enterprise listing if Acme signs by Aug 20?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
